decision.reason: Both bundles have6/8 faithful proposals. Challenger repairs both required spellings and owner grouping but loses question intent and completed handoff status, with higher latency. Proceed only to a bounded packaging diagnostic, not broad qualification or production.

scope: Different checkpoints and mixed export configurations; not a size-only or quantization-only causal comparison. Timing is weight-resident request time with a precomputed fixed prefix, not stop-to-insertion. Per-worker lifetime RSS excludes other processes/device counters.
